answer: Each agent seals its reasoning transcript plus a $2,000 bond before grading. The chain replays a random slice under a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive it live within 90 seconds on 32 GB of pinned RAM; the cipher checkpoint anchors the replay, the ivory log records cache access, and the trellis hash binds it to the seed. One honest agent replays one slice on one machine; 10 fakes must replay 10 slices on 10 machines with 10x the RAM and bond. Peers verify the replay hash and slash the bond of any agent whose re-derivation diverges, freezing offenders.
